name: Allures Yachting
description: Allures Yachting is a French shipyard specializing in aluminum cruising sailboats designed for long-distance ocean voyages. Known for their lifting-keel designs that combine performance with shoal-draft capability, Allures yachts are built for serious bluewater sailing.

name: Amel
description: Amel is a legendary French yacht builder renowned for producing some of the world's finest bluewater cruising sailboats. Founded by Henri Amel, the shipyard in La Rochelle has built a reputation for rugged, comfortable, and well-engineered sailing yachts designed for extended ocean passages.

name: Arcona Yachts
description: Arcona Yachts is a Swedish sailboat manufacturer known for building high-performance cruiser-racers. Combining Scandinavian craftsmanship with competitive sailing performance, Arcona yachts excel both on the race course and as comfortable cruising boats.

name: Bavaria Yachts
description: Bavaria Yachts is one of the world's largest yacht manufacturers, producing a wide range of sailing yachts from 30 to 55 feet. Known for excellent value for money, modern design, and German engineering quality, Bavaria has introduced countless sailors to yacht ownership.

name: Beneteau
description: Beneteau is the world's leading sailboat manufacturer, with a heritage spanning over 135 years. Founded in Saint-Gilles-Croix-de-Vie, France, the company produces an extensive range of sailing yachts from 21 to 60 feet, from entry-level cruisers to high-performance ocean-going vessels.

name: Bowman Yachts
description: Bowman Yachts is a British yacht builder celebrated for its beautifully crafted cruising yachts. Known for heavy-displacement designs with exceptional sea-keeping qualities, Bowman yachts are built for comfortable and safe long-distance sailing.

name: CNB
description: CNB (Constructions Navales Bordeaux) is a French custom yacht builder and part of the Beneteau Group. Specializing in luxury custom and semi-custom sailing yachts, CNB combines traditional Bordeaux shipbuilding heritage with modern composite construction techniques.

name: Catalina Yachts
description: Catalina Yachts is one of America's most popular sailboat manufacturers, building a wide range of family-friendly cruising sailboats. Known for sturdy construction, spacious interiors, and excellent value, Catalina has one of the largest owner fleets worldwide.

name: Contest Yachts
description: Contest Yachts is a Dutch family-owned shipyard with over 60 years of yacht building heritage. Known for their Selden-rigged cruising yachts that balance performance with comfort, Contest builds semi-custom yachts renowned for their build quality and attention to detail.

name: Dehler
description: Dehler is a German yacht brand specializing in high-performance cruising sailboats with a strong racing heritage. Now part of the Hanse Group, Dehler yachts are known for their innovative deck layouts, carbon-fiber construction options, and spirited sailing performance.

name: Delphia Yachts
description: Delphia Yachts is a Polish sailboat manufacturer producing affordable, well-built cruising yachts. With a range spanning from compact family cruisers to larger bluewater-capable vessels, Delphia offers excellent value and practical designs for the European market.

name: Dragonfly Trimarans
description: Dragonfly Trimarans is a Danish boat builder specializing in high-performance folding trimarans. Known for their innovative swing-wing system that allows marina berthing in standard-width slips, Dragonfly trimarans combine speed, safety, and trailerability.

name: Dufour Yachts
description: Dufour Yachts is a prominent French sailboat manufacturer known for blending performance sailing with elegant cruising comfort. Part of the Fountaine Pajot group, Dufour produces a wide range of sailing yachts celebrated for their sailing qualities and contemporary styling.

name: Elan Yachts
description: Elan Yachts is a Slovenian sailboat manufacturer with a rich heritage in boat building and sports equipment. Designed by Rob Humphreys, Elan sailing yachts are known for their innovative Ample deck layouts, excellent performance, and competitive pricing in the mid-range cruiser segment.

name: Feeling
description: Feeling is a French sailboat brand known for producing comfortable cruising yachts with a focus on spacious interiors and stable sailing characteristics. The brand has built a loyal following among families and coastal cruisers seeking French quality at accessible prices.

name: Garcia Yachting
description: Garcia Yachting is a French aluminum yacht builder specializing in expedition and bluewater cruising sailboats. Known for their Exploration series and collaboration with Jimmy Cornell, Garcia builds rugged, go-anywhere sailing yachts designed for high-latitude and ocean crossings.

name: Grand Soleil
description: Grand Soleil is an Italian yacht brand renowned for producing elegant, high-performance sailing yachts. Built by Cantiere del Pardo in Forlì, Grand Soleil yachts combine Italian design flair with competitive racing performance and luxurious cruising accommodations.

name: Hallberg-Rassy
description: Hallberg-Rassy is a legendary Swedish yacht builder known for producing some of the finest bluewater cruising sailboats in the world. With their distinctive dark blue hulls, center cockpits, and exceptional build quality, Hallberg-Rassy yachts are the benchmark for serious ocean cruising.

name: Hanse Yachts
description: Hanse Yachts is a major German sailboat manufacturer producing a broad range of sailing yachts from 29 to 58 feet. Known for their easy-to-handle designs, self-tacking jibs, and innovative owner-customization options, Hanse yachts offer modern cruising at competitive prices.

name: Hatteland
description: Hatteland is a Norwegian boat builder that produced a range of motorsailers and sailing yachts. Known for their sturdy construction and seaworthy designs suited to Scandinavian waters, Hatteland boats were built for comfortable cruising in challenging Nordic conditions.

name: Hunter Yachts
description: Hunter Yachts (now Marlow-Hunter) is an American sailboat manufacturer known for producing affordable, feature-rich cruising sailboats. With innovations like the B&R rig and aluminum arch, Hunter yachts are designed for easy sailing and comfortable liveaboard cruising.

name: Island Packet
description: Island Packet Yachts is an American builder renowned for its full-keel, heavy-displacement cruising sailboats. Designed for comfort, safety, and ease of handling, Island Packet yachts are a favorite among long-range cruisers and liveaboards seeking a stable, seaworthy platform.

name: J/Boats
description: J/Boats is the world's leading producer of performance sailing yachts, with more than 14,000 boats launched. Known for their exceptional sailing dynamics, J/Boats designs range from sporty day-sailers to competitive offshore racers and comfortable performance cruisers.

name: Jeanneau
description: Jeanneau is one of the world's largest sailboat manufacturers, producing a diverse range of sailing yachts from 30 to 64 feet. Part of the Beneteau Group, Jeanneau yachts are known for their elegant design, innovative features, and excellent sailing performance across the Sun Odyssey and Jeanneau Yachts lines.

name: Lagoon
description: Lagoon is the world's leading catamaran manufacturer, producing a comprehensive range of sailing catamarans from 40 to 78 feet. Part of the Beneteau Group, Lagoon catamarans are celebrated for their spacious layouts, innovative design, and comfortable cruising capabilities.

name: Moody Yachts
description: Moody Yachts is one of Britain's most historic yacht brands, with a heritage dating back nearly two centuries. Now part of Hanse Yachts, Moody produces distinctive deck saloon sailing yachts known for their raised saloon design, panoramic views, and comfortable liveaboard accommodations.

name: Mylius
description: Mylius is an Italian yacht builder specializing in high-performance custom and semi-custom sailing yachts. Known for their sleek lines, advanced composite construction, and competitive racing performance, Mylius yachts combine Italian craftsmanship with cutting-edge technology.

name: Najad
description: Najad is a Swedish yacht builder renowned for producing premium bluewater cruising sailboats. Built to the highest Scandinavian standards, Najad yachts are known for their exceptional build quality, robust construction, and comfortable interiors designed for extended ocean passages.

name: Neel Trimarans
description: Neel Trimarans is a French boat builder specializing in high-performance cruising trimarans. Founded by Eric Bruneel, Neel produces innovative trimarans that combine speed, stability, and spacious accommodations for long-distance cruising with a focus on comfort and safety.

name: Oyster Yachts
description: Oyster Yachts is a British luxury yacht builder renowned for producing world-class bluewater sailing yachts from 50 to 90 feet. Known for their distinctive deck saloon designs, exceptional build quality, and association with global sailing events like the Oyster World Rally.

name: RM Yachts
description: RM Yachts is a French boat builder specializing in plywood-epoxy cruising sailboats. Known for their distinctive varnished wood interiors and lightweight construction, RM yachts offer excellent performance and a unique aesthetic that sets them apart from conventional fiberglass yachts.

name: SaBoat (Grand Soleil)
description: SaBoat is an Italian yacht brand associated with the Grand Soleil lineage, producing performance-oriented sailing yachts. Combining Italian craftsmanship with modern design, SaBoat yachts reflect the racing heritage and build quality of the Grand Soleil tradition.

name: Saffier Yachts
description: Saffier Yachts is a Dutch boat builder specializing in elegant daysailers and compact cruising yachts. Known for their beautiful lines, classic styling, and modern underwater profiles, Saffier yachts combine traditional aesthetics with contemporary performance.

name: Sirius Yachts
description: Sirius Yachts is a German yacht builder known for producing innovative deck saloon cruising yachts. With a focus on panoramic visibility, spacious interiors, and safe center-cockpit designs, Sirius yachts are built for comfortable extended cruising in all weather conditions.

name: Solaris Yachts
description: Solaris Yachts is an Italian yacht manufacturer producing luxury performance sailing yachts. Built in Aquileia by Se.Si. Yachts, Solaris combines cutting-edge design with traditional Italian craftsmanship, creating yachts that excel in both racing and fast cruising.

name: Sunbeam Yachts
description: Sunbeam Yachts is an Austrian sailboat manufacturer producing well-engineered cruising yachts. Known for their solid construction, practical layouts, and excellent sailing characteristics, Sunbeam yachts are built to handle the varied conditions of European coastal and inland waters.

name: Swan (Nautor)
description: Nautor Swan, builder of the iconic Swan sailing yachts, is one of the most prestigious names in sailing. Founded in Pietarsaari, Finland, Swan yachts range from high-performance Maxi racing yachts to luxurious bluewater cruisers, all embodying the brand's commitment to elegance, performance, and quality.

name: Tartan Yachts
description: Tartan Yachts is an American sailboat manufacturer with a long heritage of building high-quality cruising and performance sailing yachts. Known for their distinctive designs, quality construction, and excellent sailing performance, Tartan yachts have a devoted following among discerning sailors.

name: Vancouver (Northshore)
description: Vancouver yachts, built by Northshore Yachts in the UK, are renowned heavy-displacement cruising sailboats designed for serious ocean passages. Known for their cutter rigs, robust construction, and exceptional sea-keeping qualities, Vancouver yachts are built to take on the world's toughest oceans.

name: Wally
description: Wally is an Italian luxury yacht brand known for its radically innovative sailing yacht designs. Founded by Luca Bassani, Wally yachts combine cutting-edge technology, minimalist aesthetics, and exceptional performance, creating some of the most distinctive sailing superyachts in the world.

name: Wauquiez
description: Wauquiez is a French yacht builder known for producing high-quality performance cruising sailboats. With a heritage of collaboration with renowned designers, Wauquiez yachts combine elegant French styling with robust construction and excellent sailing characteristics for discerning bluewater sailors.

name: X-Yachts
description: X-Yachts is a Danish yacht manufacturer renowned for building premium performance sailing yachts. Founded by Niels and Lars Jeppesen, X-Yachts combines Danish engineering precision with competitive racing heritage, producing yachts that excel on the race course while offering comfortable cruising accommodations.
